summary: Smithery build path traversal exposed an over-privileged fly.io token controlling 3,000+ hosted MCP server apps
root_cause: The build pipeline accepted an arbitrary dockerBuildPath in smithery.yaml, letting a build read the builder's .docker/config.json and recover a fly.io token. GitGuardian reported it 2025-06-13; Smithery rotated the token and fixed by 2025-06-15. No confirmed malicious exploitation before the fix.
